description: Scala class implementing kernel density estimation for the Spark MLlib library, supporting Gaussian kernels and providing methods for setting sample data, bandwidth, and estimating densities at given points.

classes.name: KernelDensity
classes.description: Class for performing kernel density estimation using Gaussian kernels within Spark MLlib.

methods.name: setBandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth (standard deviation) of the Gaussian kernel.

methods.name: setSample
methods.description: Sets the sample data for density estimation, accepting either RDD or JavaRDD.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Estimates the probability density function at specified points based on the sample.
